headline: Questions to Ask Before Hiring a Contractor for a Bathroom Expansion
articleBody:
Expanding a bathroom often seems simple until you start looking behind the drywall. If you are preparing to hire a remodeling contractor to enlarge your primary bath or guest suite, asking the right questions upfront protects your investment and ensures a seamless build. 

What to Prepare Before You Start

Before signing a construction agreement, ask your prospective contractor these critical questions:

- How will you verify whether our target wall is load-bearing? A reputable builder should inspect attic framing or structural plans before suggesting a wall removal, ensuring proper headers are calculated.
- Are you pulling required building, plumbing, and electrical permits? Expanding a room requires municipal permits and rough-in inspections before walls are closed; skipping these creates safety hazards and resale headaches.
- How do you handle major drain and waste relocations? Moving a toilet or main stack significantly impacts labor; ask if keeping primary lines nearby can save money while still opening up floor space.
- Who handles trade-specific connections? Ensure the builder uses qualified, insured specialists for behind-the-wall plumbing and high-draw electrical circuits.
